result.summary: The page mostly looks intact, but there are a couple of visually awkward spots: one clipped carousel/category item on the right edge and a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row that looks unintentional.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip is cut off at the screen edge, leaving only a partial pill visible.
issues.suggestion: Add side padding or slightly reduce chip width so the next category is either fully visible or clearly clipped as part of a scrollable carousel.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side, which looks like duplicate content.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and replace the duplicate card with the correct distinct restaurant item if this repetition is unintended.
